title: π0.5 Action Expert — empirical reference ceilings
label: Measured GEMM / L2 copy reference

provenance.power_clock_note: Unmodified Thor power settings; nvidia-smi observations in power_before_calibration.txt and power_after_calibration.txt. SM/memory clock telemetry reports N/A. Compute instruction domains validated by compute_application.ncu-rep. Empirical reference, unlocked clocks.
provenance.copy_method: 32-copy CUDA Graph, Triton .cg loads / .wb stores, cache-resident buffers; duration divided by 32
provenance.method: Median CUDA-event elapsed time after 5 warmups; dense GEMM, TF32 disabled; copy traffic = read + write
provenance.limitations: Achieved empirical reference, not a theoretical peak. GPU clocks are unlocked and nvidia-smi reports clock frequencies as N/A; power/temperature observations are included. Cache-resident L2 reference does not provide a DRAM roof.
provenance.instruction_path_validation: validation.json and compute_application.ncu-rep: BF16 exactly 2*N^3 tensor ops; FP32 2*N^3+N^2 SIMT ops, no BF16 tensor ops.

l2_counter_validation.note: Calibration uses logical copy bytes. Cache-warm NCU measured 0.434% more L2 traffic; rates are empirical references.
